svg.title: Shaun Teka — Animated Azure, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and DevSecOps Banner
svg.desc: A wide animated futuristic dark navy and cyan portfolio banner for Shaun Teka, featuring moving Azure telemetry, orbiting security signals, flowing network packets, a secure cloud city, animated data visualizers, a glowing mountain road, capability blocks, and technology icons. Motion is disabled when reduced motion is preferred.
